result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Create a new Modulus application

USAGE:
    modulus app <name> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    modulus app MyCompany.MyApp
    modulus app MyApp --database SqlServer

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Name of the application (e.g. MyApp or MyCompany.MyApp)

OPTIONS:
                        DEFAULT                                                 
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                      
    -o, --output        ./         Output directory (default: current directory)
    -d, --database      SQLite     Database provider: SQLite (default),         
                                   SqlServer, PostgreSQL, MySQL                 
        --no-example               Skip generating the example Catalog module

DESCRIPTION:
Generate CRUD endpoints, handlers, and entity for a domain object

USAGE:
    modulus generate-crud <entity> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    modulus generate-crud Product --module Catalog

ARGUMENTS:
    <entity>    Entity name (e.g. Product, Order)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help      Prints help information                                     
    -m, --module    Module name or namespace (e.g. Catalog,                     
                    MyApp.Modules.Catalog)                                      
        --fields    Generate with additional fields (comma-separated:           
                    name:string,price:decimal)

DESCRIPTION:
Author and apply EF Core migrations per module

USAGE:
    modulus migrate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    modulus migrate add InitialCreate
    modulus migrate add AddOrderTotals --module Orders
    modulus migrate update
    modulus migrate update --module Orders

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    add <name>    Scaffold a migration in each module's Infrastructure project
    update        Apply pending migrations to each module's database

DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a migration in each module's Infrastructure project

USAGE:
    modulus migrate add <name> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    modulus migrate add InitialCreate
    modulus migrate add AddOrderTotals --module Orders

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Migration name (e.g. InitialCreate, AddOrderTotals)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help      Prints help information                                     
    -m, --module    Only add the migration to this module (default: every       
                    module)                                                     
    -o, --output    App root directory (default: current directory)
